executive_summary: The automated test report for the web application at https://claude.ai reveals several critical issues, particularly in security and functional areas. While smoke tests passed successfully, functional tests showed multiple failures, and a critical security vulnerability was identified due to missing headers.

ai_issues.title: Missing HSTS header
ai_issues.root_cause: The HSTS security header is absent, which can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without HSTS, users are vulnerable to attacks that could compromise sensitive data, affecting user trust and compliance.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement the HSTS header to enforce secure connections.

ai_issues.title: 403 Forbidden on functional routes
ai_issues.root_cause: The server is returning a 403 status code instead of the expected 200, indicating a potential misconfiguration or permission issue.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users are unable to access key functionalities, leading to a poor user experience and potential loss of business.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Investigate server configurations and permissions to ensure correct access rights.

ai_issues.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Referrer-Policy security header is absent, which can lead to referrer leakage.
ai_issues.business_impact: Potential exposure of sensitive URL information to third parties, affecting privacy.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add the Referrer-Policy header to control the information sent in the Referer header.

ai_issues.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Permissions-Policy security header is absent, which can lead to unnecessary access to device features.
ai_issues.business_impact: Increased risk of unauthorized access to device features, potentially compromising user privacy.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement the Permissions-Policy header to restrict access to device features.

positive_findings: All smoke tests passed successfully, indicating basic functionality is intact.
No performance issues were detected, with an average response time of 168 ms.
Visual tests captured pages successfully, indicating stable rendering.
priority_actions: Implement the HSTS header to address the critical security vulnerability.
Investigate and resolve the 403 Forbidden errors on key functional routes.
Add the Referrer-Policy header to enhance security and privacy.
Implement the Permissions-Policy header to restrict unnecessary access to device features.
Review server configurations and permissions to ensure correct access rights for all users.
